programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u041/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid[divider + 1:]]
    # Locate the pattern below the divider and the rightmost object above it.
    target = [(r, c) for r in range(divider + 1, h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    tr0 = min(r for r, c in target)
    tc0 = min(c for r, c in target)
    top_colors = {grid[r][c] for r in range(divider) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 1, 2)}
    chosen = max(top_colors, key=lambda color: max(c for r in range(divider) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(divider) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == chosen]
    r0, c0 = min(r for r, c in cells), min(c for r, c in cells)
    dr = tr0 - 1 - max(r for r, c in cells)
    dc = tc0 - c0
    for r, c in cells:
        out[r + dr - (divider + 1)][c + dc] = chosen
    return out
'''
